summary: Frontend-only testing of Rank Hall + Sticker Shack reskin. All 6 test blocks passed: (1) Plaza bandstand navigates to #/rank-hall, (2) Rank Hall desktop renders marquee SOLOIST, 7 trophies with correct data-state (polliwog/tadpole/apprentice=reached, soloist=current, performer/conductor/maestro=future), avatar + bubble + next card ('Next: Performer', '1/3'), conductor trophy click updates bubble to 'Conductor — Earn 1 Master badge', TAKE A BOW triggers rank-hall-confetti + crowd shouts, how-ranks-modal portal renders, Sticker Shack button navigates to #/sticker-book, back returns to #/rank-hall. (3) Phone landscape 844x390: all 8 critical elements (marquee, shelf, you, bubble, next, bow, how, stickers) have bounding boxes fully within 844x390 viewport; actions row at y=273-310 inside 390. (4) Sticker Shack desktop: title 'Sticker Shack', dark bg, 3 earned medals + locked '?' medal, sticker-detail-modal portal shows locked PRO medal with 'how to earn' line; collection sticker modal shows image + 'Locked'. (5) Phone landscape: fit-stage-inner scroll container works; scrolling 600px + clicking sticker-char_finn opens modal centered in viewport; open-how-ranks (after scroll to top) opens how-ranks-modal centered in viewport. (6) Regression: teacher-view-toggle present/clickable, Dressing Room text present. No functional console errors observed on Rank Hall or Sticker Shack beyond pre-existing third-party warnings (Vimeo/Cloudflare Turnstile 401, audio contentType parse warnings — ignored per request).

issues: No visual overlap, but host bubble (x=122-272, y=185-259) sits in the space between the trophy shelf and the avatar; while bounding boxes are all within viewport, the bubble and avatar (x=360-484) are close vertically — looks acceptable but tight. data-scale attribute is null (page is height-locked without a measured scale value) — reporting for info only, page still fits.

critical_code_review_comments: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' observed on initial load — not reproduced in Rank Hall/Sticker Shack flows but should be investigated as it existed in prior iterations.
AnimatePresence mode='wait' with multiple children warning appears on first load — minor, won't break UX.

Portals (how-ranks-modal, sticker-detail-modal) render inside <body> and center within viewport. Trophy data-state logic verified for soloist rank.
